title: Add F1AP stats
description:
Also adds adds to the parent F1AP label the message name. This is useful especially
when there are multiple F1AP PDUs shown in the same frame.

Plus (from Pascal), fence the Info column before calling RRC dissector so that info from
multiple PDUs may be seen.

notes.body: assigned to @martin.r.mathieson
@AndersBroman , @pquantin , does this look Ok to you?
Will move to Telephony menu.. Is it worth creating an NR submenu?

Hi Martin,
I'm currently in vacation without a computer and will look at it next week.
Also on vacation.
Enjoy your vacations!

Moved to Telephony menu (from Statistics), but opted not to create an NR submenu.
We never do this kind of append in all other 3GPP dissectors as far as I know, and the message type is already in the info column. Not sure this really adds something (at least it does not for me).
Leaving in for now, but easy to remove it not helpful and adds too much clutter.

This is another array that we will need to manually keep in sync when new messages are added, which is error prone. Maybe we should have a single array that is used both for the info column and the stats. What do you think? If you consider that's not worth the pain, fine by me.
Single array is at least used now.  Not sure if would be worth making ext or not for the number of entries that it is.

My turn to be on vacation :)

We can definitely simplify the call by only having each string in one place (in the value_string), and make the call only with the ID.

For the label I added to the root, this was to make it easier, when there was multiple F1AP PDUs in one frame, to see what they are.  I was tempted to show the UE's identifier here as well. Only the last one's PDU type remains in the Info column - we could maybe fence the output after each frame.  What I have agreed to do internally is to complete a script I started which will run capture files through tshark, then rewrite it (probably as a DCT2000 .out file) with each F1AP PDU logged as a separate frame.  Then, we can filter on a UE and get a clearer view of it's message flow.
Using fences could be the way to go; that's what I also use in S1AP/NGAP for example.
Use exported pdu?
Never tried that feature - will look into it

The most recent change means that the message name strings are not repeated - they are looked up from the value_string.

I was not able to get the effect I wanted from from Info column - even when I fenced before/after the F1AP PDU it still gets cleared.

Lastly, I have played a little with 'File | Export PDUs to File...' but don't see where it might be writing out files.  Also the dialog looks a little odd (it's title for me is 'Dialog').
Could you share a pcap to check the fences? Did you look at what is done in packet-s1ap.c for example?
Done.  Have added your suggested patch to this MR.

 static int
 dissect_f1ap(tvbuff_t *tvb, packet_info *pinfo, proto_tree *tree, void* data _U_)
 {
   proto_item *f1ap_item = NULL;
   proto_tree *f1ap_tree = NULL;
 
+  struct f1ap_tap_t *f1ap_info;
+
   /* make entry in the Protocol column on summary display */
   col_set_str(pinfo->cinfo, COL_PROTOCOL, "F1AP");
   col_clear(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO);
 
+  f1ap_info = wmem_new(pinfo->pool, struct f1ap_tap_t);
+  f1ap_info->f1ap_mtype   = 0;  /* unknown/invalid */
+
   /* create the f1ap protocol tree */
   f1ap_item = proto_tree_add_item(tree, proto_f1ap, tvb, 0, -1, ENC_NA);
   f1ap_tree = proto_item_add_subtree(f1ap_item, ett_f1ap);
 
+  /* Store top-level tree */
+  top_tree = f1ap_tree;
+
+  /* Add stats tap to private struct */
+  f1ap_private_data_t *priv_data = f1ap_get_private_data(pinfo);
+  priv_data->stats_tap = f1ap_info;
+
+
   dissect_F1AP_PDU_PDU(tvb, pinfo, f1ap_tree, NULL);
+
+  tap_queue_packet(f1ap_tap, pinfo, f1ap_info);
   return tvb_captured_length(tvb);
 }
